lines: Altered mental status with refusal to eat or drink due to paranoid delusions
Patient is a 34-year-old female with schizophrenia, neuropsychiatric systemic lupus erythematosus, and antiphospholipid syndrome presenting to the emergency department.
She is found to be minimally responsive and dehydrated.
Her family reports that she has been refusing to eat or drink for the past 3 days due to a belief that her food and water are being poisoned.
- Systemic Lupus Erythematosus with Central Nervous System Involvement (Neuropsychiatric SLE) (diagnosed 2021-07-15)
Her medical history is significant for multiple hospitalizations for psychotic episodes.
She takes she has been stable on risperidone for the past year.
- Systemic lupus erythematosus in maternal aunt
- Recurrent early pregnancy loss in sister
Smoking: Never. Alcohol: None. Occupation: Production assembler.
Tachycardic with a heart rate of 110 bpm, blood pressure is 90/60 mmHg, and she is febrile with a temperature of 38.5°C (101.3°F)
She is oriented to person but not to place or time.
Suspected dehydration and acute kidney injury
The patient is started on intravenous fluids.
Once she is medically stabilized, she adamantly refuses further treatment, insisting that the hospital staff is part of the conspiracy to poison her.
She is able to articulate her understanding of her medical condition and the potential consequences of refusing treatment.
